headline: Emirates Group reports 66% profit decline amid regional conflict
summary: Emirates Group saw its first-half profit drop by 66% as regional war disruptions and rising fuel costs impacted airline operations. Passenger numbers decreased by 22% between April and September.
why: Emirates Group is a major global aviation and travel conglomerate based in Dubai. Its performance is a key indicator for the global travel and logistics sectors.

impacts.name: Emirates Group
impacts.why: The company reported a significant decline in profitability.
